shared_elements: row of repeated short strokes / repeated small motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic linear designs built from simple outlines and rows of repeated small elements, and both include curved enclosing contours, but this is about as generic as carved linear ornament gets. A depicts a single large vessel-like form with a hull outline, internal compartments and a fringe of repeated vertical strokes, whereas B depicts an anthropomorphic figure with head, face and shoulders whose back bears rings, arcs and a belt-like band \u2014 no shared specific motif or relationship.
